title: log-record
description: The canonical log record, emitted by the decision core (`foundation/logging.py`). The fields are named once here, with golden fixtures beside them, so a change to the record is a change to a contract rather than to a format string (D10).

target.description: Dotted component name, e.g. neuman.server, neuman.runner.

request_id.description: Correlates every record emitted while handling one request.

fields.description: Structured context; scalar values only — nested structure belongs in the audit chain, not the log.
